groups.why: Both rows check the same thing: inserting while a filter or sort is applied. The condition and expected result (new row above the selected row, sort/filter kept, new row editable) are identical; only the source differs (GENERAL vs CONFIRMED).
Both check the Div of a row inserted before search and the grid reset when the Div search condition changes. The condition and expected result are identical; only the source differs.
Both check inserting above a merged group on SCP0005 with the same expected result ('insert above the group if AS-IS has a merge'). Only the rule ID differs (EG140 vs EG319).

The condition says 'after Insert' and doesn't say 'before search', and the expected result is worded as 'unsaved rows = 0'. Since the state differs from V-379253e5/V-c1ccecb8, it stays alone to be safe.
Checks where the new row lands relative to the selected row (r2). This is a different expected result from EG-f4e71201 (sort kept), even though both are EG126.
Checks only that sort is kept after Insert with LT_TYPE asc applied. It has no filter or editability checks, so its scope differs from the V-5b14302f group.
Checks header merging (ColumnHeaderSpan), which is unrelated to Insert.
Trace row checking that the new row stays visible under a filter in the implementation (keepRowVisibleUnderFilter), which is a different property.
Trace row checking that GridAction.addRow/removeRow exist in the implementation.
Trace row checking the Insert hotkey binding (hotkeyConfig.insert).
Checks this screen's elements for the SYS0016 defect type (Module combo, Active default, etc.). The targets and expected results are different.
Checks the To Site combo and City mapping when inserting before search, which are different elements.
Checks the Team and Measure columns on a new row with FCST Type=ETC, which are different columns.
Checks Insert on the message-settings tab at the bottom of the screen, which is a different area.
